• **Maiden - **

 
 
• **​Maiden** over is related to the game of Cricket.
 
• In Cricket an over consists of six legal deliveries of ball towards the batsman.
 
• In the Maiden over, no run is scored which can be counted against the bowler, i.e. runs may be scored through leg byes.
